\section*{Conformance object and evidence ceiling}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Conformance object and evidence ceiling}

An implementation, representation, or product conforms only to requirements
whose complete dependencies are available and whose exact identities, values
or states, causes, lifecycles, and provenance are recorded. A finite number
never replaces a missing authority or state. Fabricated defaults, zeros,
aliases, route substitutions, source associations, covariance, response, bias,
or use decisions are nonconforming.

This ECS authors no science. The normative prose, equations, typed unavailable
register, edge matrix, SCI-POINT-REQ-001--038, and SCI-POINT-PRED-001--032 live
only in the normative core. Evidence described here can establish contract
conformance; by itself it establishes no numerical correctness,
representation or response fidelity, uncertainty coverage, observational
accuracy, validation, performance, readiness, or production authorization.

\tableofcontents

\section{Exact source, core, build, and route binding}

The cover closes the Stage A packet, r0.3 scientific directive, r0.4
presentation directive, unchanged scientific payload, this view source, and
build record. The source manifest records individual SHA-256 values. The core
digest is the exact ordered concatenation of the six accepted common modules;
an evidence run shall verify those bytes before applying this index.

Every numerical parent boundary record shall bind the POINT-facing role; exact
upstream package product role; upstream contract version; source digest; owner
approval; compatibility state; generation; and parent-response identity and
status. Admissible route families are exactly MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, and
FLT-MATCHED. Terminal FRUIT is ancestry on one such route, with terminal state
and full lineage; no intermediate iteration or coadd is admissible. The
evidence shall show that POINT neither selected nor substituted a route.

The parent source record also binds observation/array; estimand; signal unit,
calibration, normalization, WCS/grid/frame; tangent relation; support;
missing/non-finite rule; response and covariance/uncertainty status; null and
additive-reference state; inherited observation/exposure lineage or typed
\path{not_applicable}; lifecycle; and provenance. POINT creates no exposure
identity. Per-array products from one observation share exposure/reference
terms; cross-array aggregation requires separate dependence authority.

\section{Eight stage-specific logical records}

Representation syntax is implementation-defined, but stages A--H shall be
lossless, queryable, and distinct for each requested
observation-array-parent-method atom. Co-location does not merge identities.

\begin{longtable}{@{}P{0.07\linewidth}P{0.21\linewidth}P{0.64\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Stage & Record & Required logical content \\
\midrule
\endhead
A & Request and parent & Immutable request; observation/array; requested parent, method, and uses; exact parent science/identity; source reference; four applicability facts; requested search/fit domains, initialization, fallback, constraints, support/weights, and unresolved sentinels. No selected seed, fit, association outcome, realized constraint/residual, or applied/realized outcome. \\
B & Effective configuration & Every sentinel and requested option resolved to one explicit effective value or typed unavailable state. \\
C & Resolved method/plan & One frozen compatible method, route, support, objective, exact weight mapping, constraints, fallback, comparison, termination, and failure plan. \\
D & Application attempt & Applied plan, invocation/attempt identity, branch/restart/retry identity, execution state, cause, and provenance. \\
E & Realized fit/components & Selected seed; numerical values; component states; association; realized constraints; residual; diagnostics; response, bias, covariance, and uncertainty states; causes and provenance. \\
F & Publication candidate & Every required POINT value-or-status role, identity, cause, provenance, structural completeness, POINT publication state, and required links to requested child decisions; downstream success is not required. \\
G & Publication decision & POINT fit-completeness profile and bindings; decision, reasons, identity, lifecycle, and provenance. \\
H & Published product & Accepted immutable candidate; exact role, version, generation, inherited parent observation/exposure lineage or \path{not_applicable}, lifecycle, and provenance. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

Producer lifecycle is the ordered vocabulary \path{not_requested},
\path{requested}, \path{effective}, \path{unavailable}, \path{resolved},
\path{applied}, \path{fit_realized}, \path{complete_publication_candidate},
\path{publication_decided}, \path{published}, \path{failed},
\path{not_produced}, and \path{superseded}. Component identifiability and the
four SCI-VAL axes remain separate from it.

\section{Availability precedence and terminal evidence}

For each requested product, evaluate in this order: exact parent and route;
method authority; coordinate/source boundary; applicability facts; producer
attempt and realization; component identifiability; association; the
role-specific dependency; then each requested named-use profile. Stop only the
dependent product or claim and preserve independent sibling facts.

An early stop records only stages actually reached and an exact terminal
\path{unavailable}, \path{failed}, or \path{not_produced} state with cause and
release condition. It never fabricates \path{applied} or
\path{fit_realized}, never silently deletes a requested row, and never imputes
a failed array. A written unknown-scope or structural-conflict accounting
artifact may be \path{realized}; \path{failed} is reserved for failure to
produce the decision artifact. No defective or absent artifact asserts
eligibility.

The POINT fit-completeness decision at G is the sole named-use decision in base
fit completion. Pointing-support, telescope-QC, and CAL/TolProj evaluations
are independently requested immutable children of F/H. Each binds the owner
profile, immutable fit, SCI-VAL tuple, cause, lifecycle, action, and provenance;
none mutates or regenerates the fit, rescues another use, or propagates a
sibling decision. \path{diagnostic_display_only} is a consumer action, not an
axis or producer state; \path{diagnostic_only} is prohibited in those roles.

\section{Method-record acceptance criteria}

Each authority remains \path{unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval}.
The following fields are stated once; all later product rows reference this
section and stages C--E.

\Needspace{7\baselineskip}
\textbf{\CompatMethod.} One immutable, content-bound, owner-approved record
shall specify source equation and parameter ordering; width/angle conventions;
domains, constraints and boundaries; rows, residual and objective; exact
consumed $W_{\mathrm{fit}}$ and every source mapping's identity, units,
normalization, support, lifecycle, ceiling and provenance; expected-position/
search distinction; search, score, candidates, interpolation, ties,
initialization, fallback, association, retry and sentinels; solver-independent
comparison; convergence, rank, identifiability, failure and compatibility; and
applicability tests with typed unavailability.

\Needspace{5\baselineskip}
\textbf{\FormalMethod.} Its separate record shall specify fitted
parameterization; stochastic model and weight relation; exact covariance/error
construction; curvature, residual scaling, degrees of freedom, rank and
positive-definiteness; transformations and marginal extraction; bounds,
circularity, degeneracy and weak identification; consistency, units, scope,
omissions and failure states; signed standardization; and exact alias approval.

\Needspace{5\baselineskip}
\textbf{\RMSMethod.} Its separate record shall specify exact signal parent and
generation; population, centering/mean, weighting, source-region treatment,
support, edge and validity; non-finite and zero-denominator behavior; units,
lifecycle and provenance; relation to the amplitude parent; signed ratio; and
exact alias approval.

No method is released by a familiar name or presumed default. The
compatibility record gates every numerical fit. The formal-error record gates
marginal errors and formal standardization but not otherwise authorized fitted
values. The full-map-RMS record gates only its RMS scale, signed diagnostic,
and any explicitly approved alias.

\section{Product and companion record obligations}

The realized-fit record at E shall bind selected branch and seed; association
method, domain, state, and cause for every branch; support and row count;
objective and exact $W_{\mathrm{fit}}$ mapping; six role values, units, and
conventions with per-component states; constraints and rank; termination,
convergence, and retry;
model or reconstructibility; residual; diagnostics; parent null/additive state;
all response, bias, covariance and uncertainty identities/states; and every
cause and provenance link. Numerical $A$ has the exact fit-amplitude-component
role bound in the core; only established association creates the separately
typed source-associated-amplitude role.

The displacement product at F/H shall reference E and bind expected-position
identity; fitted centroid; ordered basis, handedness and positive directions;
arcsecond unit; coordinate state/time; transform/Jacobian; source and
coordinate uncertainty states; the signed equation
$\boldsymbol{\Delta}_{\mathrm{POINT}}=\widehat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}-
\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\mathrm{expected}}$; support, validity, lifecycle and
provenance. It carries no correction sign or application claim.

Each response companion at E/F shall identify exactly one scope: fixed POINT,
fixed parent, POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed, whole-chain full procedure, or
empirical bias/accuracy. It binds comparable numerical baseline/perturbed
products and states; source and association; parameter roles and gauge/order;
units/basis and component availability; perturbation source/domain/direction/
unit/$\epsilon$ and domain relation; branch changes; finite/analytic
convention; method; cause and provenance. Incomparable outputs are unavailable
or typed discontinuities/state transitions, never differences of lifecycle
objects. Whole-chain evidence requires complete upstream rerun authority;
finite differences do not compose as Jacobians without an exact theorem.

Conditional displacement covariance at E/F binds every variance and
cross-covariance in
$C_{\Delta}=C_{\widehat\mu}+C_{\mu_{\mathrm{expected}}}
-C_{\widehat\mu,\mu_{\mathrm{expected}}}
-C_{\mu_{\mathrm{expected}},\widehat\mu}$, the common basis, transforms and
Jacobians, independence authority for any zero cross term, validity, state,
cause and provenance. Missing terms make the combined covariance unavailable,
not zero or diagonal.

\section{Parity, source closure, and nonclaims}

The r0.4 parity record shall verify: unchanged six-file scientific bytes;
gap-free REQ-001--038, PRED-001--032, and UNAV-001--023 identities; equation,
product-role, lifecycle, component-state, SCI-VAL, response-family, diagnostic,
weight, exposure-lineage, owner-decision, source, and build parity; and exact
agreement between this index and the normative core. The rationale is an
explanatory view; this ECS is the evidence procedure; neither overrides or
extends the core.

The package has one-to-one coverage of ODQ-001 through ODQ-009, including
ODQ-003A/003B. The remaining actions are approval of the three exact methods,
exact route instances, four draft profiles, and any separately requested
response, bias/accuracy, or covariance authority. The deterministic delivery
packet contains the Stage A archive and sidecars, both owner directives, the
unchanged common source, all three document sources and PDFs, manifests,
parity/semantic reports, build recipe, verifier, and all-page QA record.

This specification claims no numerical route, implementation inspection or
conformity, representation or response/covariance fidelity, uncertainty
coverage, observational pointing accuracy, validation, performance, readiness,
production suitability, production authorization, or Unity activity.
